"""Provide S18_SECRET_SALT before any test module is imported.

tests/test_signer.py reads os.environ["S18_SECRET_SALT"] at module scope,
so the variable must already exist when pytest collects that file. pytest
imports conftest.py ahead of every test module in its directory, which
makes this the correct place to guarantee a value.

setdefault is used so an externally supplied secret is never overridden;
signer.signature() hashes whatever value ends up in the environment, and
the test derives its expectation from the same variable, so any single
consistent value satisfies both checks.
"""

import os

os.environ.setdefault("S18_SECRET_SALT", "ox-alpha-default-salt")
